liturgical.title_en: Monday of the First Week in Ordinary Time

primary.title_en: Monday of the First Week in Ordinary Time
primary.summary_en: This is a weekday (Feria) in the first week of Ordinary Time. The liturgical color is green, symbolizing hope and growth. The readings focus on the beginning of Jesus' public ministry and the call to discipleship.
primary.body_en: January 4th falls within the first week of Ordinary Time, following the Solemnity of Mary, Mother of God. As a Monday Feria, it does not have a specific saint's feast that supersedes the daily liturgy in most regions, though local calendars may include optional memorials. The liturgical color is green, representing the ordinary life of the Church and the steady growth of faith. The Gospel for this day typically features the calling of the first disciples or the early teachings of Christ, inviting the faithful to reflect on their own vocation to follow Him.
primary.confidence_note_en: Standard Roman Calendar assignment for this date in Ordinary Time.
